def equation(t, x, v, params):
    g = x*np.exp(-params[5]*x)
    c = np.cos(params[2]*t)
    s = np.sin(params[2]*t)
    return params[0] + params[1]*c + params[3]*s + params[4]*g + params[6]*g*c + params[7]*g*s + params[8]*v + params[9]*v*c
